ov: مَخرج 8 (اليابانية: 8番出口) هو فلم رعب نفسي ياباني صدر عام 2025 من إخراج وسيناريو غينكي كاوامورا، وبطولة كازوناري نينوميا. الفلم مستوحى من لعبة فيديو صادرة عام 2023. كان العرض العالمي الأول للفلم في عروض منتصف الليل لمهرجان كان السينمائي لعام 2025 في 19 مايو 2025، وصدر في دور العرض باليابان بواسطة شركة توهو في 29 أغسطس 2025.
plotEn:
While on a subway train, a man (credited only as the Lost Man) witnesses another man scolding a mother for failing to calm her crying baby. The Lost Man then receives a call from his ex-girlfriend, informing him that she is pregnant with his child and asking for his advice. He loses connection while trying to exit the station, and finds himself in a deserted, sterile, and seemingly endless looping corridor. Reading a set of instructions, the Lost Man learns that in order to escape, he must reach Exit 8 by turning back whenever the corridor has an anomaly, and moving forward when there is none. The anomalies he encounters range from bizarre events such as blood raining from the ceiling, to more subtle anomalies like eyes on posters tracking his movements. Any anomalies he misses return him to Exit 0, resetting his progress.
Upon reaching Exit 5, the Lost Man receives a call from his ex, who continues to implore him to help her reach a decision. He relays the altercation on the train that he had witnessed, recounting that nobody defended the woman, and tearfully confesses that his failure to stand up for her makes him feel unfit to be a father. His ex then appears in the corridor, revealing her to be an anomaly and thus sending him back to Exit 0. Upon realizing what happened, the Lost Man breaks down in frustration.
